$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Button
whenToUse: To do something: save, submit, create, delete, start a flow, open a dialog.
One `filled` primary action per area; secondary actions `outlined` or `ghost` next to it.
Inside cards and toolbars at `md`; page-level actions at the default `xl`.

whenNotToUse.text: Going to another page or section
whenNotToUse.instead: a link, or Button asChild around an <a>

whenNotToUse.text: Switching a setting on or off
Choosing one of a few options
Several related actions that don’t fit side by side

anatomy.description: a verb, sentence case: “Save changes”, “Delete domain”.
via `leftIcon`; replaced by the Spinner while `loading`, and by a tick that draws itself while `success`.
via `rightIcon` — for direction (→) or a menu (⌄).
via `badge` — a count (`{5}`, `"9+"`) or `{ dot: true }` pinned to the top-right corner; danger by default.

do.caption: One primary action; the alternative is quieter.

dont.caption: Two filled buttons compete — people can’t tell which one moves them forward.
“OK”, “Yes”, “Submit” make people re-read the question to know what they’re agreeing to.

do.caption: `softDisabled` with the reason next to it — still focusable, and it says what’s missing.
do.example: Add a title to publish.

dont.caption: A disabled button with no reason leaves people guessing, and keyboard users can’t reach it at all.

a11y: `iconOnly` buttons need `aria-label` — a dev warning fires without it.
`loading` keeps the width and the label (the spinner replaces the icon), so nothing jumps and the name stays the same.
Prefer `softDisabled` + `aria-describedby` over `disabled` when the reason matters.
A `badge` is aria-hidden — pass `badgeLabel` (“5 unread”) so the count is read with the button name; a dev warning fires without it.
The focus ring (4px) takes the button’s tone; never remove it.
Don’t nest a button inside a link or another button.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto the child element instead of a <button> (shadcn/Radix Slot convention).

props.name: badge
props.description:
Count or status pinned to the top-right corner (a BadgeIndicator, sm,
circle). Pass a number/short text (`badge={5}`, `badge="9+"`), or an
object for a dot or another tone: `{ dot: true }`, `{ value: 3, tone: 'info' }`.
Default tone is danger. Not rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
What the badge means, read after the button's name ("5 unread",
"new"). The badge itself is aria-hidden — without this, screen
reader users get no count at all. Dev warning when missing.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Renders as a square icon-only button (no label). Provide the icon via leftIcon.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label (or the sole icon when iconOnly is set).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of leftIcon and disables the button. Not supported with asChild.

props.name: softDisabled
props.description:
Soft-disable: looks disabled and ignores clicks/Enter/Space, but stays
in the tab order and keeps receiving hover/focus (uses aria-disabled
instead of the native `disabled` attribute). Use it when the user needs
to find the button and learn WHY it's unavailable — wrap it in a
Tooltip with the reason. `disabled` stays the hard version (removed
from the tab order, no events at all).

props.name: success
props.description:
The action just succeeded: a tick draws itself in place of leftIcon (Kinetics'
Status Pill, MIT). Pair it with a label that says so ("Deployed") and, usually,
`tone="success"`; turn it off again after a moment. Not supported with asChild.
